Your machine. Your traces.
No hosted service, telemetry upload, or automatic trace sharing.

      
Capture controls
Content may include prompts, source code, arguments, outputs and secrets. Pattern masking is imperfect. Opting out affects future writes; it does not erase previously saved content. Imported files discard content unless explicitly included.
History is retained until you explicitly delete a selected session. Remove a registered source before deleting its imported history to prevent it being reimported. Original files are never deleted.

      
Share the canvas, not your sessions
The public package contains only code and assets. Install it through Copilot's extension installer from the repository folder, or use “Share extension as gist” and the matching install command. Installing code does not transfer your traces.
Source, install instructions & coverage
Session exports are separate. Preview a metadata-only export from a session before downloading it. Review names and optional content before sending it anywhere.
